subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Types of homes: flats, houses, shacks, traditional homes; homes to suit different weather conditions

show.line: Homes can be houses, flats, shacks or traditional homes. Each keeps people safe!

rounds.prompt: A hot place needs a home that stays...?
A rainy place needs a roof that is...?

rounds.story: Nandi lives in a flat on the tenth floor. She takes the lift up. Does she live in a house?

hints: Homes are different but all give shelter.
Weather changes how homes are built.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! A home on the tenth floor is...
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It is a flat.

parent_line: Can name types of homes and how they suit the weather.
